controls: full_simple is historical all-TRAIN-trained reference, not an honest held-out judge. score-only uses detector score; static3/fusion4 are fit without held-video rows. Full TRAIN reference static model must reproduce formal simple.
fitting: Reuse original balanced float64 Newton/L2=.1 settings. Per full fit or fold: full-output fallback3, history-supported static3 and fusion4. Reported static3 uses full-output fallback3; supported static3 kept for exact original fitting reproducibility. Seven contexts x three optimizations=21, twelve held-arm evaluations.
limitations: Detector already saw all TRAIN; this is only judgment-rule video transfer, not unseen-detector validation.
Video frames and runs are dependent; one-error videos cannot establish a statistically stable gain.
Historical VAL/TEST repeatedly exposed; neither row set is parsed here.
Old native cache is verified by shared source loader only; no native-feature training, PCA refit or image evidence used.
Pooled delivery has fold-specific diagnostic models/cutoffs; no pooled cross-fold AUC, global policy or deployable result.
FIT video correct95 thresholds are a diagnostic working point distinct from original VAL all-frame95 policy. No policy overwrite.
No automatic next-method selection or threshold/feature/loss search from the results.
scope: Complete frozen TRAIN2558; six internal video exclusions; two judgment arms. No detector/neural updates or new VAL/TEST evaluation. No deployment or adoption.
thresholds: Diagnostic single global threshold is max of each FIT video 95%-correct quantile, including full_simple/score controls. Leave-out labels never select a threshold. Whole cutoff ties accepted. Offline evaluation correct95/same-CR points do not become online thresholds.
